subject: general
question: According to Article 79 of the Indian Constitution, the Parliament of India consists of:

options.text: only Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha
Prime Minister, Lok Sabha, and Rajya Sabha
President, Lok Sabha, and Rajya Sabha
President, Vice President, and Prime Minister

solution:
The correct answer is __**President, Lok Sabha, and Rajya Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 79** of the **Indian Constitution** defines the composition of the Parliament of India. It states that the Parliament consists of the **President, Lok Sabha (House of the People), and Rajya Sabha (Council of States).**
 
• The **President of India** is an integral part of the Parliament, as all bills passed by both houses require the President's assent to become law. This establishes the President's role as part of the legislative process.
 
• The **Lok Sabha**, also known as the **Lower House**, is composed of representatives directly elected by the citizens of India. It plays a crucial role in legislation, budget approval, and addressing public issues. *Hence, Lok Sabha is part of Parliament.*
